results.statement: If Q=a(X0+m)^2+R and an original-coordinate partition of R has rank-two cross block with singular-value product Delta, then ||p_Q||_inf <= 8 sqrt(3)|a|^(-1/2)Delta^(-1/4).

For the rank-three spectral-Schur branch, a residual two-frame with max row leverage <=1/8 admits alpha=1/4 partition and ||p_Q||_inf <=16 sqrt(3)(|a|c|det Lambda|)^(-1/4); under c>1/2, |a|>=1/2, |det Lambda|>=1 this is <=16 sqrt(6).

Every nonsingular binary Schur residual after a nonzero physical diagonal pivot is quantitatively closed by recursive coarea plus HLS when a Schur diagonal is nonzero, and by a sharper direct conditional half-Riesz estimate when that diagonal vanishes.
